instruction: A candid lifestyle photograph in a medium full shot captures a bright indoor dining room with wooden floors and a large potted plant. The man in the white t-shirt (R1) sits on a white chair on the left, facing right and smiling while holding a slice of pizza on a plate. Opposite him, the blonde woman in the olive green t-shirt (R2) sits on the right, facing left and smiling as she holds her pizza slice. They sit facing each other at a light wood dining table, sharing a pizza from an open cardboard box placed between them. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural side lighting, creating a warm, casual atmosphere with soft shadows.
